title: Fear recedes in humble company
summary: Meeting humble beings cuts the messenger of death down to size, and mercy settles where panic had been speaking. Let company that carries the True One steady your next breath.
takeaway: Move toward humble company before fear becomes your counselor.
lifeApplication: When fear starts narrating the room, step toward a person, line, or sangat rhythm that carries mercy instead of panic.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting humble beings conquers the death-fear, and the Merciful Master comes to dwell in the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When fear narrows you, move toward company that carries mercy instead of panic.

evidence.coreClaim: Humble company does not merely soothe fear; it lets the Merciful One dwell where death-anxiety had been ruling.
evidence.turn: Move toward the humble until fear loses its command.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear starts narrating the room, step toward a person, line, or sangat rhythm that carries mercy instead of panic.
